briefdescription.para: Creates a sequence of conditional statements to select a branch.

detaileddescription.para: Given a sequence of jump statements, JUMP[i], JUMP[i+1], ..., JUMP[end-1], this routine creates a sequence of 'if' statements of the form,
if (JUMP_VAR == i) JUMP[i]; else if (JUMP_VAR == i+1) JUMP[i+1]; else ... if (JUMP_VAR == end-1) JUMP[end-1];
